context: Mother and child set the table together — tying a scarf, putting on hats
purpose: Teach: 帽子/グラス/暖かい/家事/開ける/並ぶ/富/結ぶ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔、お手伝いありがとう。家事を一緒にすると早く終わるね。
lines.en: Sho, thanks for helping. Chores finish faster when we do them together.
lines.style: Warm maternal voice, appreciative and gentle, slightly upbeat tempo

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん!お皿、ちゃんと並ぶように置いたよ。グラスもここでいい?
lines.en: Yeah! I lined up the plates neatly. Is the glass okay here?
lines.style: Bright child voice, eager and proud, slightly excited pitch

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 上手だね。じゃあ窓を開けるから、ちょっと待ってて。今日は本当に暖かいね。
lines.en: Well done. Let me open the window first, hold on. It's really warm today.
lines.style: Soft maternal tone, calm guidance, gentle and reassuring delivery

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねえママ、この帽子かぶってもいい?パパの結婚式の写真にあったやつ!
lines.en: Hey mom, can I wear this hat? The one from dad's wedding photo!
lines.style: Curious child voice, playful and inquisitive, rising intonation

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、いいよ。でもスカーフは私が結ぶから、こっち向いて。
lines.en: Hehe, sure. But I'll tie the scarf for you, turn this way.
lines.style: Amused maternal laugh, affectionate and patient, soft warm tone

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、この絵本に「富」って漢字あるよ。お金持ちって意味?
lines.en: Mom, this picture book has the kanji for wealth. Does it mean rich?
lines.style: Inquisitive child voice, genuine curiosity, slightly thoughtful pause

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうそう、よく知ってるね。さ、座って。りんごジュース注ぐよ。
lines.en: Yes, exactly, you know it well. Now sit down, I'll pour apple juice.
lines.style: Encouraging maternal voice, praising and warm, smooth flowing delivery

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: やった!いただきます、ママ!
lines.en: Yay! Thanks for the food, mom!
lines.style: Joyful child exclamation, bright and energetic, high happy pitch
